answer: Use surprise checks, quick as a sparrow: at a random minute each epoch, every identity gets its own seed-derived question and must reply within 90 seconds, scored by 5 random established peers. An operator running 200 fakes must write 200 distinct, good answers in the same 90 seconds, so effort grows 200x, not 1x. Weakness: one fast model can mass-produce replies. Fix: answers over 0.85 embedding similarity or near-identical reply timing form a grove that shares a single reward, and a basalt flag keeps those identities merged for 10 epochs.
